messages:
maria-support: Opening thread for support ticket #9021 (CareSync Medical). They're asking for a streaming completions endpoint that can: emit typed JSON frames, include in-band function/tool invocation frames, preserve global ordering, and allow clients to request a resume token after disconnect. They also want clear schema versioning and a small client ack mechanism so they can drop duplicates.

maria-support: Use case: assisted intake clerks see incremental suggestions and trigger hospital systems via function calls as suggestions appear. Peak load estimate: 80 concurrent streams, occasional spikes to 250 for 10-15m.

maria-support: Ticket link: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/9021 (has user sample transcripts and proposed frame examples).

lee-product: Thanks. Quick clarifying Qs: 1) Do they expect websockets, SSE, or webhook POSTs for frames? 2) How important is exactly-once processing vs at-least-once? 3) Is there a client-side library requirement?

maria-support: They prefer webhook POSTs to their ingest endpoint (server-to-server), websockets are not in their infra. They want "near exactly-once" for fn calls (dedupe via client-generated idempotency token is OK). SDK would be nice but not required for POC.

devin-eng: Engineering take: delivering typed frames + fncall actions over webhook POSTs works, but we need to solve: backpressure (customer may return 429s), ordering across retries, storage for short-lived stream checkpointing, and clear wire format that won't break our streaming parser.

devin-eng: MVP idea: 1) frame envelope: {"frame_type","frame_id","stream_id","seq","schema_version","payload"}; 2) fncall frames include an "idempotency_key" and optional "callback_url"; 3) provide resume token as base64 of last-seq + stream-id, valid for 60s. Implementation estimate: spike 5 days + 2 sprints for hosted path; webhook retry/backpressure handling may require separate infra work.

tina-sales: CareSync is evaluating Dedicated for compliance reasons. This ask could be tied to a Q3 pilot (deal ~ $180k ARR). Sales requests high priority label if we can commit to pilot timeline. :moneybag:

lee-product: Noted — we need a value note and runway. Tina please confirm pilot timeline and whether they need audit logs/KMS in scope. We'll also need launch criteria: RFC approved, SDK sample, latency SLOs per chunk (<300ms typical), resume semantics documented, and customer POC signoff.

nora-ux: UX asks: sample JS webhook consumer that reorders frames correctly and handles fn_call frames as atomic actions. Also we should provide a small demo UI that shows progressive rendering of content and inline call triggers. I'll mock this after we have the wire RFC.

maria-support: Customer wants a sync next Wed to review concrete wire examples. I've scheduled it and included their lead engineer.

devin-eng: I'll do the spike. Deliverables: RFC draft with framing proposal, webhook retry/backpressure guidance, example curl/post snippets, and a tiny node consumer example. Due in 7 working days. If RFC approved, we can scope implementation.

devin-eng: Proposed example frames (wire):

```json
{"frame_type":"partial","stream_id":"s-abc123","seq":5,"frame_id":"f-0005","schema_version":"v1","payload":{"text":"Vitals show elevated BP"}}
{"frame_type":"fn_call","stream_id":"s-abc123","seq":6,"frame_id":"f-0006","schema_version":"v1","payload":{"fn":"create_task","args":{"patient_id":1234},"idempotency_key":"kXz-77"}}
{"frame_type":"final","stream_id":"s-abc123","seq":7,"frame_id":"f-0007","schema_version":"v1","payload":{"summary":"Recommend follow-up call"}}
```

lee-product: Triage decision: make RFC ticket and label "customer-streaming-frames-fncall". Priority: high (sales-influenced). Owner: devin-eng (spike). Spike due: 7 business days.

tina-sales: I'll add the commercial context + confirm pilot dates by EOD.

nora-ux: I'll prepare example consumer code and mocked UI once RFC draft lands.

ci-bot: Created RFC issue RFC-2021: customer-streaming-frames-fncall 17 url: https://prod.redwood.ai/rfcs/RFC-2021

lee-product: I'll add RFC-2021 to next planning column "awaiting estimate" and tag for product review. Thanks team.

maria-support: Sync with CareSync Wed 11am PT. I'll share RFC link in ticket when available.
